strategy_descriptions.arrival_chorale: All 32 pitches arrive together after a shared breath; a sustained chord opens into a softer repeated answer.
strategy_descriptions.harmonic_breaths: Dense sustained choirs take turns inside each harmony, joining at every harmonic arrival.
strategy_descriptions.arrival_waves: Every new chord enters in a close wave; a few quarter-note pulses animate the sustained ensemble.
strategy_descriptions.opening_aperture: The full chord announces each change, then thins to a few voices and exposed lines before its next arrival.
strategy_descriptions.cantabile: A shaped upper melody, then its answer, over a quiet sustained triad; a short lower countermelody appears in the gaps.
strategy_descriptions.triad_residence: A single sharp-third triad is explored through sustained, broken, and overlapping voicings before another root answers.
strategy_descriptions.seventh_dialogue: Two four-note sonorities alternate, with a slower seventh crossing the moving triad underneath.
strategy_descriptions.contrary_invention: Two recurring motifs move in opposite contours, then exchange their rhythmic roles over a sparse harmonic floor.
strategy_descriptions.layered_trios: Two major-triad families in contrasting registers overlap; one holds while the other unfolds, then they exchange roles.
strategy_descriptions.melody_and_bells: A sustained melodic thread above gently spaced plucked notes; a small middle voice answers the melody.
strategy_descriptions.root_madrigal: Two root families trade related melodic sentences, then sing together in a brief three-part close.
strategy_descriptions.sighing_duet: Paired descending figures answer ascending pickups, with long phrase endings and a quietly changing chord underneath.
strategy_descriptions.seventh_residence: A seventh sonority is given a whole six-bar span, with its seventh sustained above a breathing triad.
strategy_descriptions.two_part_canon: A small turning motif returns after a beat in another register, with a longer answer and a quiet held support.
strategy_descriptions.passacaglia: A slow recurring bass figure supports a repeated upper motif whose ending changes, then settles.
strategy_descriptions.farewell: Fragments of the earlier melody and its two chord families alternate, becoming quieter and more widely spaced.

dynamic_envelope.interpolation: linear decibels between section centers, with final fade to -34 dB
